tei:div.tei:p: )ji snyed phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du// snga 'gyur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i srol// phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig ༈ mdo sngags chos tshul tshang la ma nor ba// mkhas shing grub brnyes rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i srol// thub bstan snying po gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i// bstan pa 'phel rgyas 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig ༈ bslab gsum 'phags pa'i nor gyis legs phyug cing*// spang klog 'khor lo gsum gyis dus 'da' ba'i// 'dus pa rgya mtshos gnas 'di yongs gang nas// bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rdzogs ldan gsar 'char shog ༈ 'og min sa la spyod pa dpal gyi zhing*// padma dgyes pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i mdzod// rig 'dzin ḍākki'i 'du gling dga' ba'i tshul// srid pa'i rgyan gyur rtag khyab bde legs shog ༈ e waṃ zung 'jug bde chen mu khyud zlum// mdo sngags chos 'khor bshad sgrub rtsibs stong bkra// mtshungs med rnga yab gling pa'i ring lugs 'di// srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams 'phel rgyas shog ༈ bdud 'dul padma rgyal po'i ring lugs mchog /snga 'gyur rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde yis// yangs pa'i khyon gang nub med rab brtan cing*// phrin las 'dzam gling kun khyab bkra shis shog ༈ theg mchog gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can// thub bstan gling bzhi'i mkha' la yongs 'phags te// 'jigs bral chos kyi rgyal srid 'byor pa'i dpung*// phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis dpal 'bar shog ༈ rnam dag dad dam gtsang ma'i zhing sa la// lhag bsam smon lam sa bon gang btab pa// rten 'byung bslu med drod gsher gyis smin te// don gnyis 'dod pa'i snye ma g.yur za shog ༈ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog
ces sogs dus skabs dang 'brel ba'i smon lam dang bkra shis kyi rim pa ji ltar rigs pa rgya cher spel bas bde legs su bya'o/// /
